review.title: Website content readiness
review.description: This workspace identifies the evidence, stories, and service information needed before launch. Placeholder language is for internal review only and must not be published as fact.
review.contentOwner: Pass by Ira leadership and communications team

sections.title: Annual impact
sections.publicPlacement: Homepage after the mission; expanded on an impact or transparency page
sections.reason: Donors need evidence of what Pass by Ira accomplished, not only statistics describing homelessness across DFW.
sections.draftHeadline: What your support made possible in [reporting year].
sections.draftBody: [Add a 35–50 word summary connecting verified outputs to the organization’s mission. Distinguish Pass by Ira results from regional homelessness statistics.]
requiredInputs: Reporting period and program scope
Three to four verified output or outcome metrics
Internal source and approver for every number
Short explanation of what changed because of the work
verificationGate: Every figure reconciles to an internal record
Reporting period appears beside the metrics
Outputs are not presented as long-term outcomes
Leadership approves the final wording

contentFields.label: Reporting period
contentFields.guidance: Use one consistent period across all metrics.

contentFields.label: Metric 1
contentFields.guidance: Name the exact source and avoid double-counting.

contentFields.label: Metric 2
contentFields.guidance: Prefer an organizational result over a regional need statistic.

contentFields.label: Metric 3
contentFields.guidance: Include only if it adds a distinct dimension of impact.

sections.title: Current impact story
sections.publicPlacement: Homepage near impact evidence; full story in Events & Stories
sections.reason: Ira’s origin story explains why the organization began. A current story shows what the work means for people today.
sections.owner: Program and communications leads, with story subject approval
sections.draftHeadline: [First name or approved descriptor]: one moment of care, followed through.
sections.draftBody: [Write a 90–140 word story grounded in dignity and individual agency. Include a clear beginning, the support provided, and a specific present-day outcome. Avoid savior language and unverified transformation claims.]
requiredInputs: Story subject with documented consent, or approved anonymous framing
Concrete support Pass by Ira provided
Specific and current outcome
Approved documentary photograph and alt text
verificationGate: Written consent covers story and image use
Subject has reviewed sensitive details where appropriate
Language preserves the subject’s dignity and agency
Outcome can be confirmed by the program team

contentFields.label: Story subject
contentFields.guidance: Use only the level of identification covered by consent.

contentFields.label: Support provided
contentFields.guidance: Describe the organization’s role accurately and without exaggeration.

contentFields.label: Outcome
contentFields.guidance: State what is known now; do not imply permanence without evidence.

sections.title: Volunteer opportunities
sections.publicPlacement: Get Involved page with a concise homepage preview
sections.reason: A generic sign-up asks volunteers to commit before they understand the role, schedule, location, or expectations.
sections.draftHeadline: Choose a role that fits the way you want to show up.
sections.draftBody: [Add a short introduction explaining whether opportunities are recurring, seasonal, individual, group-based, or skills-based. Set a clear expectation for response time after sign-up.]
requiredInputs: Three to five active volunteer roles
Typical schedule, location, and time commitment
Age, orientation, transportation, or background requirements
Group and corporate participation options
verificationGate: Every listed role is currently available
A staff owner is assigned to volunteer inquiries
Sign-up confirmation explains the next step
Seasonal opportunities include dates or an update cadence

contentFields.label: Direct outreach role
contentFields.guidance: State what the volunteer will actually do.

contentFields.label: Behind-the-scenes role
contentFields.guidance: Include preparation, logistics, communications, or professional skills.

contentFields.label: Group opportunity
contentFields.guidance: Make corporate and community-group participation concrete.

sections.title: Help and referral pathway
sections.publicPlacement: Persistent utility link in the header or footer; dedicated resource page
sections.reason: People who need assistance—and the people supporting them—need a clear, timely path, even when Pass by Ira is not the direct service provider.
sections.draftHeadline: Need help right now? Start with the right local resource.
sections.draftBody: [State plainly what Pass by Ira can and cannot provide. Add verified DFW crisis, shelter, food, rental-assistance, and coordinated-entry resources with operating details.]
requiredInputs: Approved description of Pass by Ira’s direct-service scope
Primary referral partners and current contact information
Emergency and after-hours guidance
Resource review owner and update schedule
verificationGate: Every phone number and link has been tested
Hours and eligibility are current
The page does not promise services Pass by Ira cannot provide
Resources are reviewed at least quarterly

contentFields.label: Pass by Ira service scope
contentFields.value: [What we provide / what we do not provide]
contentFields.guidance: Use direct language and avoid making visitors infer eligibility.

contentFields.label: Primary DFW referral
contentFields.guidance: Confirm the referral accepts the intended need and geography.

contentFields.label: Emergency guidance
contentFields.guidance: Separate emergencies from routine service navigation.

sections.title: Trust and transparency
sections.publicPlacement: Who We Are or a dedicated Transparency page; concise trust signal near donation calls
sections.reason: Evidence-oriented donors, grantmakers, and partners need governance and financial information before committing support.
sections.owner: Board chair, treasurer, and executive director
sections.draftHeadline: Accountability is part of how we serve.
sections.draftBody: [Add a 40–60 word transparency statement and links to approved governance, reporting, and donor-policy documents.]
requiredInputs: Current board and leadership roster
Most recent Form 990 or filing status
Annual report or year-in-review
Privacy, donor, and conflict-of-interest policies approved for publication
verificationGate: Documents are current and board-approved
EIN and legal name are consistent everywhere
Sensitive internal information has been removed
A named owner maintains the page annually

contentFields.label: Annual report
contentFields.guidance: A concise year-in-review is acceptable if a formal report is not yet available.

contentFields.label: Tax filing
contentFields.value: [Form type, year, document URL or filing explanation]
contentFields.guidance: State the organization’s current filing status accurately.

contentFields.label: Governance and policies
contentFields.guidance: Publish only documents approved for public access.

sections.title: Case for support and sustaining gifts
sections.publicPlacement: Donation page and immediately before external checkout links
sections.reason: A donor should understand what unrestricted support enables before leaving the site for the donation form.
sections.owner: Executive director, treasurer, and development lead
sections.draftHeadline: Your gift helps care show up—and keep showing up.
sections.draftBody: [Explain in 50–75 words how unrestricted gifts support direct outreach, coordination, education, and organizational capacity. Add monthly giving language only if the checkout is configured accordingly.]
requiredInputs: Approved description of unrestricted fund use
Verified cost examples or honest gift-level ranges
Monthly giving availability and stewardship process
Donation form payment and receipt settings
verificationGate: Gift examples reflect actual costs and do not overpromise
Restricted and unrestricted giving are distinguished
Monthly giving can be selected and managed in checkout
Tax receipt and donor contact information are correct

contentFields.label: Core donation promise
contentFields.guidance: Connect the gift to the operating model, not an invented one-to-one outcome.

contentFields.label: Gift example
contentFields.guidance: Use a range or ‘helps provide’ language when costs vary.

contentFields.label: Monthly giving
contentFields.guidance: Confirm the donation platform supports the promise before publishing.

sections.title: Community partnerships
sections.publicPlacement: Homepage trust band and partnership page
sections.reason: Accurate partner recognition helps supporters understand Pass by Ira’s role within the larger DFW homelessness response system.
sections.draftHeadline: Working alongside organizations committed to a stronger DFW.
sections.draftBody: [Add a short statement describing how Pass by Ira collaborates with service providers, businesses, funders, and community groups. Do not imply formal partnerships without approval.]
requiredInputs: Approved partner list and relationship type
Logo-use permission and current brand assets
One sentence explaining the value of each partnership category
Partner contact responsible for approval
verificationGate: Every named partner has approved public recognition
Logos follow partner brand requirements
Relationship language is accurate
Former or inactive partners are excluded

contentFields.label: Service-system partners
contentFields.guidance: Clarify whether the relationship is referral, program, or coalition-based.

contentFields.label: Corporate and funding partners
contentFields.guidance: Confirm recognition requirements before publishing logos.

contentFields.label: Community partners
contentFields.guidance: Keep the list current and meaningful rather than exhaustive.

sections.title: Current needs and update cadence
sections.publicPlacement: Announcement bar and Get Involved page
sections.reason: A current-needs list is useful only when supporters can trust that it is current and know exactly how to deliver items.
sections.draftBody: [Add accepted conditions, quantities or priority items, delivery instructions, and a contact or wishlist link. Remove items promptly when the need changes.]
requiredInputs: Prioritized item list and accepted condition
Drop-off or shipping instructions
Update date and content owner
Wishlist or alternate giving option if available
verificationGate: The visible updated date is accurate
Delivery instructions have been tested
Items not currently accepted are clearly excluded
A monthly review reminder is assigned

contentFields.label: Last updated
contentFields.guidance: Display this date publicly near the list.

contentFields.label: Priority items
contentFields.guidance: Use specific, distribution-ready descriptions.

contentFields.label: Delivery method
contentFields.guidance: Tell donors what happens after they choose to help.
